title: Exploring Test Smells Across Programming Languages: A Systematic Mapping Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.21613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tests are essential for ensuring code quality in software development. However, poor implementation practices can compromise the maintainability and evolution of test code, leading to additional costs and effort. These practices, known as test smells, have been the focus of numerous studies that expanded the catalog of known test smells. Despite this progress, little attention has been given to examining test smells from the perspective of programming languages, particularly their relationship with specific languages or test frameworks. As a result, researchers and practitioners have proposed various approaches and tools to detect and refactor the same test smells across different languages. In this work, we address this gap by analyzing test smells in the literature from a programming language perspective. translated_title: 探索跨编程语言的测试坏味：一项系统性映射研究
translated_abstract: 测试对于确保软件开发中的代码质量至关重要。然而，不良的实现实践可能会损害测试代码的可维护性和演化，导致额外的成本和工作量。这些实践被称为测试坏味（test smells），已成为众多研究的焦点，这些研究扩展了已知测试坏味的目录。尽管取得了这些进展，但从编程语言的角度审视测试坏味却很少受到关注，特别是它们与特定语言或测试框架之间的关系。因此，研究人员和从业者提出了各种方法和工具来检测和重构不同语言中的相同测试坏味。在这项工作中，我们通过从编程语言的角度分析文献中的测试坏味来填补这一空白。我们开展了一项系统性映射研究，收集了截至2025年8月发表的论文数据，共审查了117篇论文。我们识别了……
tldr: 该研究通过系统性映射方法分析了截至2025年8月的117篇论文，首次从编程语言视角系统审视测试坏味，填补了测试坏味与特定编程语言及测试框架关系研究的空白。
en_tdlr: This work presents a systematic mapping study of 117 papers published up to August 2025, examining test smells from a programming language perspective to fill the gap in understanding their relationship with specific languages and test frameworks.
